standards.value: Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS) in the UK Public Sector, from 1 April 2025

plan_period.quote: The plan analyses the different areas of the Council’s activity that Internal Audit have risk assessed as needing to be audited over a three-year timeframe.

team.quote: The Audit Team consists of five staff; the Audit Manager, a Principal Auditor, two Senior Auditors and one Auditor post.

risk_themes.theme: Significant pressure on the Council's finances; reserves largely used
risk_themes.relevance_reason: budget pressure raises the stakes of uncontrolled spend
risk_themes.quote: significant pressures on Council finances during 2022/2023 and 2023/24 required utilising almost all earmarked reserves, especially risk reserves.

risk_themes.theme: Rising costs of adult and children's social care and Home to School Transport
risk_themes.relevance_reason: these are the largest purchased services in the spend data
risk_themes.quote: the financial pressures here are due to increase of inflationary costs for adult and children social care, increase in complexity and quantity of demand for social care services, increase of Home to School Transport costs

risk_themes.theme: High demand for social care and housing services
risk_themes.quote: Performance data for 2022/23 and 2023/24 shows a significant increase in demand for children’s and adult social care services, and housing services.

risk_themes.theme: Need for a cost base reduction of over £30m
risk_themes.relevance_reason: savings pressure on contracts and suppliers
risk_themes.quote: the need for a cost base reduction of over £30m.

risk_themes.theme: Pressure on public sector finances nationally
risk_themes.quote: Pressure on public sector finances – over the last two years an unprecedented number of Council either issued a S114 report or have requested Exceptional Financial Support from the Government.

risk_themes.relevance_reason: procurement fraud is a fraud-risk area
risk_themes.quote: Increase communication regarding risk exposure especially in relation to fraud risk, and the actions being taken to mitigate risks.

risk_themes.theme: Re-introduction of a controls assurance process
risk_themes.relevance_reason: assurance over controls includes purchasing controls
risk_themes.quote: Support the re-introduction of a controls assurance process.

risk_themes.theme: Annual Anti-Fraud Work Plan linked to the Audit Plan (Appendix E, not in the file)
risk_themes.relevance_reason: fraud work may cover procurement; its content is not in the papers
risk_themes.quote: Good practice as stated in CIPFA’s Fighting Fraud and Corruption Locally requires an Annual Anti-Fraud Work Plan to be prepared which links to the Audit Plan, a draft plan is attached as Appendix E.

risk_themes.relevance_reason: sets the financial loss the Council aims to operate with
risk_themes.quote: The Council aims to operate with a financial risk between £250k – £500k.

risk_themes.theme: Compliance risk appetite: Flexible/Open, including high value transactions
risk_themes.relevance_reason: compliance with procurement rules on high value transactions
risk_themes.quote: The Council aims to operate with a legal risk that finely balanced between flexible and open, following approved standards and practices as far as possible but also allowing for innovation, willing to engage in new areas of work, of significant public interest, and related to high value transactions.

risk_themes.theme: External audit of 2021/22 and 2022/23 accounts not completed (disclaimed opinion expected)
risk_themes.relevance_reason: less external assurance over financial controls
risk_themes.quote: The Financial Statements for 2021-22 and 2022-23 are likely to have a ‘no-fault disclaimed’ opinion.

scoring_method.reason: likelihood scale (Table 2), impact scale (Table 1) and the combining matrix (Figure 1) with RAG bands (Table 4) are all present
scoring_method.quote: The Council evaluates its identified risks on a five-point scale on the likelihood or probability of the risk occurring (rated between rare and certain) and the impact caused should the risk occur (rated between negligible and critical).

evaluation_levels.definition: likelihood and impact without additional, specific mitigation action
evaluation_levels.quote: Gross level – likelihood and impact without additional, specific mitigation action.

evaluation_levels.definition: current likelihood and impact, based on mitigation already in place
evaluation_levels.quote: Actual level - this is the current likelihood and impact, based on mitigation action already put in place but excluding further mitigation action planned.

evaluation_levels.definition: future likelihood and impact after planned additional mitigation
evaluation_levels.quote: Expected level – this is a future level of likelihood and impact based on any additional mitigation action (if any) planned to further address the triggers and the consequences of risks.

likelihood_scale.label: Certain
likelihood_scale.definition: Risk will occur within a 12 month period
likelihood_scale.quote: Risk will occur within a 12 month period

likelihood_scale.label: Almost Certain
likelihood_scale.definition: Risk is almost certain to occur within a 12 month period
likelihood_scale.quote: Risk is almost certain to occur within a 12 month period

likelihood_scale.label: Likely
likelihood_scale.definition: Risk is likely to occur within a 12 month period
likelihood_scale.quote: Risk is likely to occur within a 12 month period

likelihood_scale.label: Unlikely
likelihood_scale.definition: Risk is unlikely to occur within a 12 month period
likelihood_scale.quote: Risk is unlikely to occur within a 12 month period

likelihood_scale.label: Rare
likelihood_scale.definition: Risk is very rare and highly unlikely to occur within a 12 month period
likelihood_scale.quote: Risk is very rare and highly unlikely to occur within a 12 month period

impact_scale.label: Critical
impact_scale.compliance: Probable legal challenge with penalties. Probable regulatory intervention.

impact_scale.label: Major
impact_scale.assets: Majority loss of main building / Loss of main ICT system
impact_scale.reputation: Adverse publicity nationally; HSE / Fire Authority prosecution
impact_scale.compliance: High possibility of legal challenge. High possibility of regulatory intervention.

impact_scale.label: Medium
impact_scale.assets: Partial loss of main building or total loss of minor building; temporary loss of major ICT system up to one week
impact_scale.reputation: External agency criticism – EG Auditor, Ofsted etc.; HSE / Fire Authority enforcement action
impact_scale.compliance: Reasonable possibility of successful legal challenge. Reasonable possibility of regulatory interest.

impact_scale.label: Minor
impact_scale.personal: Major financial loss £1,000+; illness e.g. stress / minor accident / RIDDOR
impact_scale.assets: Partial loss of minor building; temporary loss of minor ICT system
impact_scale.compliance: Low possibility of legal challenge. Low possibility regulatory interest

impact_scale.label: Negligible
impact_scale.personal: Minor financial loss up to £1,000 / complaint / grievance
impact_scale.assets: Loss of minor ICT system up to one day
impact_scale.compliance: Negligible possibility of legal challenge or regulatory interest
impact_scale.quote: 1 Negligible Less than 0.01% annual WBC budget £17.5k
